description: This file defines a Java interface 'TaxRateDao' for data access operations related to tax rates within the sales management system. It declares methods for retrieving tax rate information based on various criteria such as store, country, zone, tax class, code, and language.

classes.name: TaxRateDao
classes.description: A data access interface for tax rate entities, extending generic DAO functionalities and providing specific methods for retrieving tax rates based on store, location, and tax class criteria.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Returns a list of tax rates associated with a specific merchant store.

methods.name: listByCountryZoneAndTaxClass
methods.description: Retrieves tax rates filtered by country, zone, tax class, store, and language.

methods.name: listByCountryStateProvinceAndTaxClass
methods.description: Retrieves tax rates filtered by country, state/province, tax class, store, and language.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a tax rate by its unique code within a specific store.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Overloaded method to list tax rates for a store with language context.
